scope: Two complete physical-board studies plus one explicitly limited final-fork pattern; five source-complete larger studies retain analysis notes. Original v3 unchanged.

dqzv6GtbHPI.notes: Four branches from the complete five-piece physical-board setup Black Kc5/Ne8/h7 versus White Ke5/g6. Only h6 wins. The h6/Ke6/Kd4/Kf7/Ke5/Kxe8/Kf6 knight sacrifice and h6 king-chase representative remain Black wins. h5 gives a drawn promotion race; hxg6 lets White catch the remaining pawn. Captions name Kf5 after hxg6, but the actual physical diagram supports Kf4: Kf5 would enter the g6 pawn’s attack. The correction and independently selected replies are disclosed.

cYXGqMq9JSg.notes: Four branches from the complete seven-piece physical diagram Black Kf7/Be1/Nf2/g7 versus White Kh5/b7/h2. Only g6+ wins. The Bb4/promotion/Be7/Kg3/Bd6/Qxd6/Ne4 fork and alternate Bd2/Bf4 blockade preserve the win. The main fork’s final Kf4 reply is independent. Premature Ne4+ loses to the uniquely winning Kh3 reply; an independently tested Kg4 instead gives the win back to Black. Every intermediate result is checked, including both sides of that error.

v_aWkyFdqgw.notes: Three short final-pattern comparisons only, beginning after Qxf4 at 75s in the seven-piece diagram White Kb3/Nc3/a5 versus Black Kc1/Qf4/f6/h7. Ne2+/Kd2/Nxf4 wins the queen and the exact six-piece ending. Independent a6 or Nb1 loses. Earlier larger queen/rook trades and Bg3/Bf4 bishop offer remain source context and are not certified by the final fork.

yvhvc0ZCuGw.notes: All 30 saved diagrams and narration were reviewed. The a5/Nc6/Qa8/Kg7 queen-trapping phase retains nine pieces, including a5/d4 and a6/c7. The complete source is present.
yvhvc0ZCuGw.analysis_required: Reconstruct and verify the larger pawn-check, knight defense of a5 and Kg7 zugzwang with supported engine/forced-tree analysis. Keep the spare pawns in every comparison; winning the queen at the end does not certify the earlier nine-piece choices.

USn1Z8GHBQ8.notes: All 75 saved states and narration were reviewed. The central bishop-versus-pawn stalemate cage has ten pieces: White Kf6/Bh5/a4/b3/c5 against Ka5/a6/b4/c6/f7. It later reaches a smaller won pawn ending after the bishop sacrifice and king captures, but those terminal diagrams do not establish the larger timing choices. Source is present.
USn1Z8GHBQ8.analysis_required: Verify the larger Kf5/Kg4/Kh3 king path, bishop access to e2, Bxa6 sacrifice, stalemate errors and queen-race alternatives with supported larger-position analysis. Preserve the a/b/c pawn cage rather than removing it to fit tablebase limits.

-MD-izjC-Yk.notes: All 39 saved diagrams and narration were reviewed. The two-rooks-versus-queen maneuver starts with ten pieces and retains eight in the final pawn mate: White Ka6/Rd7/b7/c7/b5 against Kb8/Qf7/b6. Source is complete.
-MD-izjC-Yk.analysis_required: Verify the larger Rce1/Re6/Re7/Rf7 communication-cutting plan, Qg7 queen offer and Rxc7 capture alternatives, including the refused-queen stalemate and final pawn mate, using supported engine/forced-tree analysis.

NGgEOuT6ZMI.notes: All 55 saved states and narration were reviewed. The rook chase and knight-fork net retain many a/b/d/e/f pawns even after the knight is removed or the queen won, so the substantive phases exceed seven pieces. Source is present.
NGgEOuT6ZMI.analysis_required: Reconstruct and verify the larger Rb4/Qc8/Rb8/Qh3/Rh8/Nh4/Rxh4 chase, queen retreats and fork alternatives using supported larger-position analysis. Check the claimed draw after ordinary exchanges independently of the narration about rating.

4Iuof5bMC8c.notes: All 43 saved states and narration were reviewed. The Rc8/Nb4/Rb8/Rb5/Rd5/Ra5 queen-trapping composition begins with nine pieces; even after the queen capture it retains eight because both sides’ c/f pawns and White’s e-pawn remain. Source is complete.
4Iuof5bMC8c.analysis_required: Verify the larger rook-offer/king-hunt sequence and final knight fork, preserving c3/c4/e4/f6 and checking every alternative king retreat with supported engine/forced-tree analysis. A terminal queen capture alone is not proof of the initial nine-piece tactic.
